name: Resinous sunflower
desc: Resinous sunflower (Helianthus resinosus): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Helianthus resinosus is a North American species of sunflower known by the common name resindot sunflower. It is native to the southeastern United States from Mississippi to North Carolina.
